written.myAnswer: System software manages and controls a computer’s hardware and provides a platform for application software. Examples include an operating system and device drivers.
An operating system manages the computer’s hardware resources, provides a user interface, and supports communication between applications and the computer.
Utility software helps maintain, protect, or improve a computer system. It is important for system performance, security, and reliable operation.
Device drivers let the operating system communicate with hardware devices so the computer can use them.

System software manages or supports the computer and includes operating systems and device drivers. Application software helps users perform specific tasks, such as writing documents in Microsoft Word or organizing data in a spreadsheet.
Spreadsheet software arranges data in rows and columns, performs calculations, and helps users analyze and present data.
In education, graphic design software can be used to create visual learning resources such as diagrams, posters, charts, and illustrations that help explain ideas.
Backups are copies of data that can be restored if the original files are lost, damaged, or deleted. They can be made by copying files to external storage or a cloud service.

System software manages and controls hardware, supports application software, and helps the computer operate effectively. Operating systems manage resources and provide a user interface, drivers enable communication with hardware, and utilities help maintain performance and security. Without system software, applications would lack the support needed to work with the computer.

An operating system manages hardware resources and provides a user interface; Windows is an example. Utility software maintains or protects the computer; Disk Cleanup is an example. Device drivers enable communication between the operating system and hardware; a printer driver is an example.

System software manages and supports the computer and provides a platform for applications; examples include operating systems, utilities, and device drivers. Application software performs specific tasks for users; examples include word processing, spreadsheet, presentation, and graphic design software.

Use a disk-cleanup utility to remove unnecessary files and free storage. Run maintenance tools to check and manage the system, and use antivirus software to scan for and remove threats. Keep the operating system and security software updated, and back up important data to external or cloud storage. These actions help maintain performance and protect data.

Identify the hardware and obtain its compatible driver, then install it using the installer or the computer’s device-management tool. To update it, install a newer compatible version and restart if needed. If the device has problems, check its connection and status, then update or reinstall the driver and test the device again.

Word processing software creates and edits text documents. Spreadsheet software organizes and analyzes data and performs calculations. Presentation software arranges information into slides. Graphic design software creates visual content such as drawings, illustrations, and logos.
